change: Scoped single notice when current consent is declined, cancelled or invalid; no composer write
scope: Captured session plus monotone approval presentation revision, incremented before replacing old approval. Superseded-session/ticket callbacks are silent. Same-session paused outcomes remain in transcript; authorization and speech foreground guards are unchanged.

cases: decline/cancel/expired current consent: exactly one notice, draft unchanged
replacement: old callback silent, successor binding/dialog unchanged
session change: no old notice in new transcript; new request can still report its own decline
actual pause/cancel/resume: current outcome persists once, draft retained, no research or speech
